Use case: illustration-story. Asset: one complete full-bleed portrait 2:3 tarot illustration, Ten of Swords. The first 1 reference image(s) are exact Dragon Quest character identity/costume references; the LAST is ONLY the approved deck ink/color/texture style, not a scene or person to copy.
Scene and exact characters: Actual DQV Pankraz/Papas: burly adult father with messy black hair, a thick black MUSTACHE but no beard, a cream one-shoulder leather top crossed by dark straps, tooth necklace, blue fur-trimmed cloak, dark loose trousers and a red hip pouch as official. He kneels thoughtfully on a grassy hill at DAWN, alive, uninjured, dignified. Exactly TEN steel swords stand planted in the earth behind and to either side, FIVE left and FIVE right, all ten distinct hilts and blades visible. None touches his body and he carries no extra sword. A symbolic end of a difficult chapter with warm sunrise, no bodies, no blood, no battle or funeral. Preserve actual character design, clean manga ink and cel colors, no text/frame.
Shared deck art direction: faithfully drawn Akira Toriyama Dragon Quest characters, clean confident black ink outlines, expressive recognizable faces, crisp hand-painted cel color blocks, restrained shadows and a subtle watercolor-paper grain matching the approved illustration. Original illustration, NOT a 3D screenshot, product photograph, plush, collage or card mockup. Full-bleed single cohesive artwork edge to edge, mobile-readable clear silhouettes and large key symbols.
Hard constraints: no title, no typography, no letters or numerals, no UI, no watermark/logo, no borders or card frame. Any writing, decorative labels, copyright line, duplicate background portraits or layout boxes on reference sheets must NOT appear. Preserve actual named DQ characters, hairstyle/clothing/colors, not generic original substitutes. Keep the stated number of tarot objects exact; avoid incidental extra cups/swords/coins/wands. Do not mix in characters from other franchises.
visual_review: Pankraz actual cream leather one-shoulder top, tooth necklace, blue fur cloak, black mustache and red pouch retained. Exactly five planted swords left and five right, ten total; alive/uninjured, no text/frame.
